item.description:

item.title: Nationalism Can Curb Doctor Brain Drain, Says KPPA
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: Beyond Chemo, New Blood Cancer Treatments Bring Hope In Malaysia
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
A haematologist at Sunway Medical Centre, Sunway City, says stem cell transplant can be curative in many instances, while CAR-T cell therapy is lifesaving in Refractory B cell lymphoma, B cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia and multiple myeloma.
